## Hook Semantics & Ordering

**Hook Contract** (`packages/model/src/index.ts:186-199`):
- `tokens(ctx: TokenHookContext)` → returns full `Token[]` replacement (later plugin wins on collision)
- `icons(ctx: IconHookContext)` → returns `IconEntry[]` to add (NOT replacement; entries converted to tokens)
- `css(ctx: CssHookContext)` → returns `CssContribution` (prepend/append/properties/declarations)

**Ordering & Dedup** (`packages/core/src/plugin.ts:121-161; packages/core/src/build.ts:238-242`):
- `buildTokens` flow: base tokens → icon tokens → `runIconPlugins` → `runTokenPlugins` 
- `runIconPlugins`: plugins receive current icons (name/viewBox/source only, no SVG), append entries
- Entries with no `svg` nor `path` are skipped (no token produced)
- Context provides existing icons so plugins can skip duplicates manually
- **Dedup by name happens last via `dedupeByName`** after all plugins run — later token wins
- Invalid CSS custom property names dropped with warning (D7 security control)
- SVG content in `<image>` tokens sanitized via `sanitizeImageToken` (sanitizeSvg from utils)

**Collision Semantics**:
- Both token and icon hooks run (icon adds, token may override)
- Same icon name registered by multiple plugins → plugin runs in order, last-wins after dedup
- Custom icons already override same-named Lucide glyphs in base `collectIcons` via Map precedence

## Built-in Plugin Configuration

**Three existing plugin packages in plugins/pantoken/**:
1. `@pantoken/plugin-custom-icons` (custom-icons/) — vendored SVG icons from assets/icons, generated metadata
2. `@pantoken/plugin-lucide-lab` (@lucide/lab only, Lab subset)
3. `@pantoken/plugin-colors` — CSS-native color helpers (darken/lighten/alpha/overlayColors)

**NOT auto-registered** — consumer must pass to `buildTokens({ plugins: [...] })` or `toCss({ plugins: [...] })`

**Icon layer built-in (no plugin required)**:
- `buildTokens` calls `iconTokens()` by default (respects includeIcons/includeInstui/includeLucide flags)
- `iconTokens()` calls `collectIcons()` which:
  - Reads Custom glyphs from @instructure/ui-icons/svg/Custom (metadata: source=custom, style=Custom)

- `readLucideGlyphs()` uses ui-icons' wrapped registry (es/generated/lucide/index.js)
- Parses lucide-react ESM distribution (dist/esm/*.js/.mjs, tolerates both extensions)
